card.title: Nintendo Switch Console turns on shows first logo and goes black Repair

source.title: Nintendo Switch Console turns on shows first logo and goes black Repair

claims.statement: Switch that shows the first logo then goes black: try a known-good battery and screen (a bad LCD can stop many Nintendo consoles booting), then a new M92T36.

card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
